overview: The Atlantic Hotel stands in central Newquay with views over Newquay Bay and the harbour. Alongside a range of hotel rooms, including family rooms and balcony suites, it offers two self-catering apartments, one sleeping eight. Guests get access to the indoor pool, hot tub, sauna and steam room, and there is a restaurant and cocktail bar.
